Materials Matrigel (BD Biosciences BD354277) mTesR1 (Stem Cell Technologies 5870) STEMdiff Neural Induction Media (NIM; Stem Cell Technologies 5831) Accutase (Fisher AT104) DMEM/F12 (Invitrogen 11039021) FBS (Invitrogen 26140079) Knockout Serum Replacement (KOSR; Invitrogen 10828-0 28) DMSO (Sigma D2650) PLO (Sigma P4957) Rock Inhibitor (Y-2 7632; Fisher 50811206) Laminin (Sigma L2020) STEMdiff Neural Rosette Selection Reagent (Stem Cell Technologies 5832) BDNF (Sigma SR3014) GDNF (Sigma G1777) Dibutyryl cAMP (D0260)

steps.title: Prepare feeder-free iPSC culture
steps.instruction: Establish iPSC cultures using sterile technique on Matrigel-coated plates.

substeps.instruction: Coat appropriate sized tissue culture dish with Matrigel, swirl to distribute, and let set for 1hr at room temperature or in a 37 °C humidified chamber (typically 1mL Matrigel per well for a 6-well plate).
Prepare mTeSR1 feeder-free medium by adding 100mL of thawed 5x supplement to 400mL Basal Medium; add 5mL penicillin/streptomycin if needed, mix, and warm to room temperature.
Thaw iPSCs (1-2 x 10^6 cells/mL) in a 37 °C water bath.
Add 1 mL of thawed iPSC to 9 mL of DMEM/F12 in a 15mL conical tube (do not mix) and centrifuge at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate medium from the pellet and add 2mL of mTeSR1 supplemented with Rock inhibitor (10 µM final), avoiding breaking up cell clumps.
Aspirate Matrigel from the dish and add 2mL of suspended iPSCs.
Place plate in 37°C, 5% CO2 and 95% humidified chamber, using a “T” motion for even distribution.
Change medium with 2mL of fresh mTesR1 daily; increase to 3mL per well as iPSCs become more confluent.

steps.title: Form neural aggregates
steps.instruction: Convert confluent iPSCs into neural spheres in a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Harvest iPSCs at 75-85% confluency by aspirating medium, rinsing with 2mL DPBS, adding 1mL Accutase, and incubating at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Gently tap the plate, dilute Accutase with 4mL DMEM/F12, and collect the suspension in a 15ml conical tube.
Centrifuge at 750 rpm for 3 minutes, aspirate medium, and add 3 mLs of neural induction medium to the pellet.
Count iPSCs using a hemacytometer and adjust the suspension to 450,000-650,000 cells/mL using neural induction medium supplemented with Rock inhibitor (10 µM final).
Add 100 µl of iPSC suspension per well to a v-bottom 96-well plate and centrifuge at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 and 95% humidified chamber for 24 hrs.
After 24 hrs, replace all medium with 100µl per well of Neural Induction Medium without disturbing the spheres.
Incubate for 4 additional days, performing daily half-volume medium changes (remove 50ul, replace with 50ul).

steps.title: Prepare plates for neural rosettes
steps.instruction: Coat tissue culture plates with Poly-L-Ornithine (PLO) and laminin.

substeps.instruction: Coat 3 wells of a 6-well plate with 1ml PLO for 2hrs or overnight in a humidified incubator.
Aspirate PLO and rinse 3 times with DMEM/F12.
Dilute laminin to 10 µg/mL final in cold DMEM/F12 and add 1 mL/well to PLO coated plates; incubate for 2 hrs or overnight in a humidified incubator.

steps.title: Form and select neural rosettes
steps.instruction: Plate neural aggregates and select for rosette structures.

substeps.instruction: On Day 5 of aggregate formation, wash spheres 2 times with 100 µl pre-warmed DMEM/F12 (alternatively, remove 50ul media and wash with 50ul DMEM/F12).
Remove the last wash and add 50 µl of neural induction media to each well.
Aspirate laminin from a pre-coated well and transfer 32 spheres per well using 100 µl volumes with 200 µl sterile tips.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 and 95% humidified chamber, distributing cells with a “T” motion.
After 24 hrs, replace medium with 2mls/well fresh neural induction medium daily. If aggregates are not attached, use 1ml/well until 90-100% attach, then return to 2mls/well.
Monitor daily; harvest when spheres flatten and clusters are visible (3-7 days post-plating).
Harvest by aspirating medium, rinsing with 1ml pre-warmed DMEM/F12 to remove unattached cells, and adding 1ml Neural Rosette Selection reagent.
Incubate for 30-45 minutes at 37 °C (check at 20 min) until rosettes round up.
Carefully remove selection reagent, add 1mL DMEM/F12, and detach rosette clusters by rinsing with a p1000 (do not triturate).
Transfer material from 1 well to a 15mL tube for banking and from 2 wells to a separate 15mL tube for expansion.
Centrifuge rosette clusters at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.
Prepare 2x stock freezing medium by adding 10 m Ls sterile DMSO to 40 mLs sterile KOSR in a 50 ml conical tube; mix by inverting 3-4 times and store at 4° C (up to 4 weeks).
Aspirate supernatant from the 1-well rosette collection tube.
Add 1.5 mLs neural induction media and 1.5 mLs 2x neural freezing medium to the clusters.
Gently mix and distribute 1mL into sterile cryovials.
Store at -80 °C for at least 48 hrs, then transfer to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Expand neural progenitors
steps.instruction: Expand neural rosette clusters into neural progenitor cells (NPCs).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate laminin from 2-3 wells of a PLO-laminin plate.
Remove supernatant from the 2-well rosette collection tube and add neural induction media (NIM) to reach 2mL per well.
Pipet clusters up and down to break them into 1/4 or 1/5 original size.
Add 2 mL of suspension to each well and incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 and 95% humidified chamber for 24 hours.
Replace medium with 2 mL fresh NIM daily for 3-5 days until ~80% confluent.
Prepare 'Complete Media' by adding 2 mL FBS to 10 mL DMEM/F12.
Rinse cells with 1 mL/well DMEM/F12, add 1 mL/well 0.05% trypsin, and incubate at 37 °C for 3 minutes.
Inhibit trypsin by adding 4mL Complete Media to each well; collect cells in a 15mL tube and centrifuge at 750 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend in 12 mLs NIM, pipetting at least 3 times to break large clumps.
Passage cells to PLO-lamin plates at 2 mLs/well for 6 wells.
Feed with 2 mLs fresh NIM daily until 85-95% confluency.
Maintain NPCs by passaging at a 1:3 dilution.
Harvest NPCs at ≥85% confluency and perform a cell count in 3 mLs of NIM.
Add equal volumes of NIM and 2x neural freezing medium to the suspension to reach 1 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Gently mix and distribute 1mL into sterile cryovials.
Store at -80 °C for 48 hrs, then transfer to liquid nitrogen.
Aliquot 9 mLs pre-warmed DMEM/F12 into a 15 ml conical tube.
Thaw cells in a 37° C water bath for ~30 seconds until a small ice clump remains.
Add thawed cells to the 9 mLs DMEM/F12 and mix by shaking the tube 3 times gently.
Centrifuge at 750 rpm for 3 minutes and aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend in 2 mLs NIM and plate into one well of a 6-well plate.
Ensure NPCs are at passage 4 or lower to avoid astrocyte contamination and ensure efficiency.
Plate cells in NIM on pre-coated PLO/laminin plates at appropriate densities: 150K/well (12-well plate), 75-50K/well (48-well plate), or 30K/well (8-well chamber slides).
